name: entitlement-schedule
title: Entitlement schedule
for_each: select id,code from entitlements order by code

sections.title: Recorded licence terms
sections.note: Internal record, not a signed licence or activation credential.

sections.title: Feature allowances
sections.sql: select feature,monthly_limit from feature_grants where entitlement_id=$1 order by feature

sections.title: Recorded allocations
sections.sql: select code,device_ref,last_seen_on,released_on from allocations where entitlement_id=$1 order by code

name: renewal-brief
title: Renewal evidence brief
for_each: select id,code from v_entitlements where plan_type='subscription' and expires_on<=current_date+60

sections.title: Renewal
sections.note: Draft for internal approval. No commercial offer or automatic renewal.

sections.title: Outstanding work
sections.sql: select code,title,owner,due_on from tasks where entitlement_id=$1 and closed_on is null order by due_on

sections.title: Entitlements held
sections.sql: select code,product,offering,status from v_entitlements where account_id=$1 order by code
